categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of categories to be executed.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: List of checks to be executed.

checks-file.title: Checks File
checks-file.description: JSON file containing the checks to be executed. See config/checklist_example.json

checks-folder.title: Checks Folder
checks-folder.description: Specify external directory with custom checks (each check must have a folder with the required files, see more in https://docs.prowler.com/user-guide/cli/tutorials/misc#custom-checks-in-prowler).

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.description: Compliance Framework to check against for. The format should be the following: framework_version_provider (e.g.: cis_3.0_aws)

credentials-file.title: Credentials File
credentials-file.description: Authenticate using a Google Service Account Application Credentials JSON file

custom-checks-metadata-file.title: Custom Checks Metadata File
custom-checks-metadata-file.description: Path for the custom checks metadata YAML file. See example prowler/config/custom_checks_metadata_example.yaml for reference and format. See more in https://docs.prowler.com/user-guide/cli/tutorials/custom-checks-metadata/

excluded-checks-file.title: Excluded Checks File
excluded-checks-file.description: JSON file containing the checks to be excluded. See config/checklist_example.json

excluded-project-ids.title: Excluded Project IDS
excluded-project-ids.description: Excluded GCP Project IDs to be scanned by Prowler

gcp-retries-max-attempts.title: GCP Retries Max Attempts
gcp-retries-max-attempts.description: Set the maximum attempts for the Google Cloud SDK retry config (Default: 3)

ignore-exit-code-3.title: Ignore Exit Code 3
ignore-exit-code-3.description: Failed checks do not trigger exit code 3

list-checks-json.title: List Checks Json
list-checks-json.description: Output a list of checks in json format to use with --checks-file option

list-compliance-requirements.title: List Compliance Requirements
list-compliance-requirements.description: List requirements and checks per compliance framework

list-fixer.title: List Fixer
list-fixer.description: List fixers available for the provider

list-project-id.title: List Project ID
list-project-id.description: List available project IDs in Google Cloud which can be scanned by Prowler

list-resource-groups.title: List Resource Groups
list-resource-groups.description: List the available check's resource groups

list-services.title: List Services
list-services.description: List covered services by given provider

mutelist-file.title: Mutelist File
mutelist-file.description: Path for mutelist YAML file. See example prowler/config/<provider>_mutelist.yaml for reference and format. For AWS provider, it also accepts AWS DynamoDB Table, Lambda ARNs or S3 URIs, see more in https://docs.prowler.com/user-guide/cli/tutorials/mutelist

only-logs.title: Only Logs
only-logs.description: Print only Prowler logs by the stdout. This option sets --no-banner.

organization-id.title: Organization ID
organization-id.description: GCP Organization ID to be scanned by Prowler

output-directory.title: Output Directory
output-directory.description: Custom output directory, by default the folder where Prowler is stored

output-filename.title: Output Filename
output-filename.description: Custom output report name without the file extension, if not specified will use default output/prowler-output-ACCOUNT_NUM-OUTPUT_DATE.format

output-formats.title: Output Formats
output-formats.description: Output modes, by default csv and json-oscf are saved. When using AWS Security Hub integration, json-asff output is also saved.

project-ids.title: Project IDS
project-ids.description: GCP Project IDs to be scanned by Prowler

push-to-cloud.title: Push To Cloud
push-to-cloud.description: Send findings in OCSF format to Prowler Cloud. Requires PROWLER_CLOUD_API_KEY environment variable. For the IaC provider, --provider-uid is also required. More details here: https://goto.prowler.com/import-findings

resource-groups.title: Resource Groups
resource-groups.description: List of resource groups to be executed.

scan-secrets-validate.title: Scan Secrets Validate
scan-secrets-validate.description: Validate secrets discovered by the secrets checks by checking whether they are live against the provider APIs. WARNING: this makes outbound network calls using the discovered secret itself; the credential is exercised against the provider and the call appears in the audited account's logs. Disabled by default.

services.title: Services
services.description: List of services to be executed.

shodan.title: Shodan
shodan.description: Check if any public IPs in your Cloud environments are exposed in Shodan. We recommend to use the SHODAN_API_KEY environment variable to provide the API key.

skip-api-check.title: Skip Api Check
skip-api-check.description: Assume all APIs are active and skip the active API check for each service

slack.title: Slack
slack.description: Send a summary of the execution with a Slack APP in your channel. Environment variables SLACK_API_TOKEN and SLACK_CHANNEL_NAME are required (see more in https://docs.prowler.com/user-guide/cli/tutorials/integrations#configuration-of-the-integration-with-slack/).

status.title: Status
status.description: Filter by the status of the findings ['PASS', 'FAIL', 'MANUAL', 'MUTED']

unix-timestamp.title: Unix Timestamp
unix-timestamp.description: Set the output timestamp format as unix timestamps instead of iso format timestamps (default mode).

verbose.title: Verbose
verbose.description: Runs showing all checks executed and results
